concept.title: Integration
concept.shortdesc: Red Hat Quay integrates with Git-compatible systems such as GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket and provides a full OAuth 2 REST API. You can configure continuous builds from your repositories and manage Red Hat Quay through the API.

section.title: REST API
section.p: Red Hat Quay provides a full OAuth 2, RESTful API. RESTful API offers the following benefits:

ul.li: Availability from endpoints of each Red Hat Quay instance from the URL, for example, https://quay-server.example.com/api/v1
Allow users to connect to endpoints through a browser, to GET, DELETE, POST, and PUT Red Hat Quay settings provided by a discovery endpoint that is usable by Swagger.
The API can be invoked by the URL, for example, https://quay-server.example.com/api/v1, and uses JSON objects as payload.
